## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible outcome.

## Scope

List what is included and explicitly out of scope.

## Linked issue

Link the relevant issue (for example, `Closes #123`) or explain why none exists.

## Tests and results

List the checks run and their results, including any checks not run and why.

## Compatibility

- [ ] I reviewed API compatibility and documented any intentional changes.
- [ ] I reviewed data compatibility and documented any persistence impact.

## Documentation

- [ ] I updated affected documentation, or no documentation change is needed.

## Sensitive-data review

- [ ] I confirmed this change contains no secrets, credentials, private data, databases, or sensitive logs.
- [ ] I confirmed there are no accidental DSH submodule source modifications.
